title: Global search lists an inactive part with a grey Inactive tag
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • The top-bar Search is the new global search, which is on by default for every account.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL GSTAG PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-02), with description {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL GSTAG PART B), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is active.
  • {Part-A} and {Part-B} share the start of their numbers (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-0).
custom_steps:
1. Click "Search" in the top bar (or press Ctrl+K).
  2. Type the start that {Part-A} and {Part-B} share (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-0).
  3. Read the parts results.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Both {Part-A} and {Part-B} are listed. {Part-A} carries a grey "Inactive" tag; {Part-B} has no tag.

Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R18, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows global search.
